source.work: Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture (M. Fowler, 2002)
source.paraphrase: A repository looks like a collection of domain objects. Callers do not see the query rows the infrastructure used to load them.

invariants.why: The row is the database's shape. Returning it makes every caller depend on column names and nullability the domain did not choose.
invariants.fixHint: Map the columns onto the domain type in the repository and return that value. Keep the row type private to the repository file.
invariants.avoid: return row as Invoice and return { ...row } are the same leak. return row.id is a field read, not this rule; a mapper that still returns the whole row is.
